title: Strip leaked `</content>`/`</invoke>` tool-call artifacts from committed planning docs
why: Both files end with literal leftover XML-ish tags from whatever agent tool call authored them (an unstripped Write/Edit tool-call content boundary), not markdown content — verified via direct `tail`/`grep` on disk, independent of any tool rendering. Harmless to rendering but signals the authoring pipeline occasionally commits raw tool-call framing into tracked docs.
recommendation: Delete the trailing artifact lines; add a pre-commit/`make audit` grep for `^</(content|invoke)>$` under docs/ to catch this class of leak before commit (Rule 0 style).
acceptance_criteria: A committed check greps docs/ for stray tool-tag artifacts.
